The '''Crystal Sea''' was an [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] located in the southern hemisphere of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Auratera/Legends|Auratera]]. The stilt [[City/Legends|city]] [[Dewbright/Legends|Dewbright]] was located on the eastern coast of the Crystal Sea, within a natural harbor.<ref name="NoP" />
